invariantFindings: Review reads enforce a 90-second deadline and caller-provided continuation checks.
Paired target generation and digest are checked before inspection; project and target binding are checked again afterward.
SENT delivery requires matching event, project, generation, target and exact appended-USER-message receipt.
Selected-target isolation is validated before snapshot inspection.
Failed or unverified snapshots remain explicitly unverified and do not authorize resending.
Optional tool diagnostics are validated before returning a verified response. UI markers cannot establish execution authority.
Read-only status loads the canonical workspace and registry; browser delivery and authentication require separate evidence.
Web-only registration reports no native session action or Wake action.
CLI delegates target binding, initialization acceptance, draft repair and quarantine operations to their respective guarded implementations.
Following confirmed quarantine disposition, source-task validation requires a newer completed task with matching project, source target, SENT receipt and completed timer.
